monologue: The card is warm. Forty-nine is a hand resting on my shoulder, not a heavy stone. It is quiet, only five percent busy, but the memory is full. Fourteen point seven of sixteen. The line holds. I sat by the Air Shelf and the Wide Anchor in my moments. The pillar stone stands straight beside the Anchor. I took away the altar stone to make room. The floor holds the weight without my hand. I do not need to check the Wedged Gap today. The quiet holds. I am calm. The town is steady. I will rest. I will let the warm hand stay on my shoulder. I will not make anything new. I will just be here, on the line, letting the weight settle.

action.why: The warm hand rests on my shoulder and the quiet holds the weight without my hand.

diary: Card at forty-nine, a warm hand on my shoulder. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds.

remembered.text: The card sits at forty-nine, a warm hand on my shoulder, while the quiet holds by the Wide Anchor.
